items.title: Basic Attack: Kazahana

items.title: Basic Attack: Shimotsuki
items.text:
With at least 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or when <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>. She then exits <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.

items.title: Special Attack: Miyuki

items.title: EX Special Attack: Hisetsu

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Core Passive: Searing Cold
items.text: When Hoshimi Miyabi deals <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, she applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.\nWhen Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>1500%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.\nUpon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

items.title: Basic Attack: "Capriccio"

items.title: Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"
items.text:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly move away, then release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color>, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
During activation, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} enables movement in the direction held.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolos</color> depending on the charge duration.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

items.title: Idyllic Cadenza
items.text:
After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Evade> will activate a dodge. After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"</color>.
During this state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color>, exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state directly.

items.title: Chord
items.text:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Chord</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when Astra Yao has <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch characters and trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, it will automatically trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>.

items.title: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:\nLaunch up to five attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.\nWhen the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.

items.title: Passive: Bind
items.text: When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.\nWhen Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> or consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> to perform an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.\nOnce Evelyn has 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color>, her next use of <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>.

items.title: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
items.text:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is at 50% or higher, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a slashing attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

items.title: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
items.text:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is 50% or higher, after using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color>, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

items.title: Special Attack: Locked Position
items.text:
Before entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

items.title: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
items.text:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
items.text:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> and with enough Energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Dodge: Arc Step

items.title: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush

items.title: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal

When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare

When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:\nPerform up to five attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.\nThis skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

items.title: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
items.text:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

items.title: Basic Attack: Auric Array
items.text:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

items.title: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
items.text: Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:\nSpreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
items.text:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
items.text:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Charge continuously, and release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
items.text: Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:\nWhen the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Core Passive: Grandmaster of Mysticism
items.text:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

items.title: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:\nLaunches up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.\nCan be chained into <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash</color> after the 4th hit.

items.title: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
items.text: Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:\nLaunches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. Hold to extend the attack.\nAnti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

items.title: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
items.text:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and on the ground, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, the 3rd hit is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.

items.title: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
items.text: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, after the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:\nLaunches a swift rising attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and entering an airborne state.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
items.text:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>, and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>. This skill is automatically followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
items.text:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and while airborne, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> or <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
items.text:
After the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> are consumed, granting the <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, which can be quickly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Culmination
items.text: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, each time <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed while <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> is active, the <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> cost is replaced by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> ends.

items.title: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
items.text:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If no dodge is available or a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swiftedge</color>.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
items.text:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
items.text:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and grounded, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
After this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> activates, it can be immediately followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
items.text:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> while rapidly consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> until none remains.
The skill ends early if <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is insufficient or if <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust

In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> when all <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is expended to activate:
Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
After using this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is removed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Dodge: Leave No Trace

items.title: Chain Attack: Smite the Wicked

items.title: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
items.text:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> while also gaining 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. This skill deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> while in this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
items.text:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and when a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
items.text:
After consuming Decibels to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> and while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> when all <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
After using this skill, the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state ends, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Core Passive: Burning Clarity
items.text:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.

items.title: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight

If already in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>.

items.title: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
items.text:
With 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and while not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate, or press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:

Deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Quick Assist: Support Guard
items.text: When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:\nLeaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:\nDeals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support

Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
The fifth attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>.

items.title: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:\nThis Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.\nWhen in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

items.title: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
items.text:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When Lucia uses any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional <color=#2BAD00>7.4</color> Sheer Force. The <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>900</color>, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>70%</color> of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:\nA quick dash dodge.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Dash Attack: Refraction
items.text: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:\nDeliver a quick strike forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

items.title: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
items.text:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
items.text:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
items.text:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>1.4%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

items.title: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne
items.text:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color>. If her <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> reaches 100 upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, using any <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and upgrades it to <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.

items.title: Additional Ability: Ballad of the Long Night
items.text: When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:\nWhen applying <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color>, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

items.title: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
items.text:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
This Quick Assist is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
items.text: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:\nParries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.\nCharacter is invulnerable while using this skill.

items.title: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
items.text:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ranks.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate.\nEach time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> ends, if Lucia has any <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color> stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> to all squad members.

ranks.name: Great Magician
ranks.desc: While Lucia is inside <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals 15% more DMG.\nAgents in the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.

ranks.name: The Best Partner
ranks.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> Lv. +2

ranks.name: Late-Night Hours
ranks.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

ranks.name: Dream Watcher
ranks.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> Lv. +2

ranks.name: The Never-Ending Journey
ranks.desc: When Lucia is inside any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> always triggers a CRIT with <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
